notablePrerequisites:
Rune-Scarred Demon and Krothuss do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Krothuss and Rune-Scarred Demon.
description:
Declare Krothuss and Rune-Scarred Demon as attackers.
Krothuss triggers, creating a token copy of Rune-Scarred Demon that is tapped and attacking.
The Rune-Scarred Demon token enters the battlefield, causing you to search your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and put it into your hand.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.

uses.name: Runo Stromkirk // Krothuss, Lord of the Deep
uses.cardState: as Krothuss, Lord of the Deep
